decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits at the core of the firm's established heat-exchange business and its announced efficiency direction, so the firm is publicly and strategically committed to it and any weak early results can be put down to normal ramp-up.
The air cooled condenser is close to the established offer and was launched only recently with visible website presence, so sunk development costs and the need to justify the launch favor keeping it.

Despite some overlap with Product B, this condenser variant shares the same engineering investment and public commitment, so management would sooner treat any slow uptake as temporary than withdraw it.

The tube liner for corroded heat exchangers extends the firm's lifecycle service strategy and draws on its repair expertise, making it central to the announced service direction and worth persisting with.
Customized industrial air coolers embody the firm's stated competitive edge in integrated tailored solutions, so dropping them would contradict its public positioning.
Tube end repair inserts fit the firm's repair and spare-parts service portfolio, cost little to keep, and are tied to its lifecycle-services commitment, so keeping them is the natural choice.
